dimensions.detail: The skill's buyer-question research, grounded post generation, quality gates, public publishing, and attribution tracking fit its stated growth-operator purpose. Public posting and performance tracking are impactful, but they are clearly described and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions include clear boundaries: do not expose BLOGBURST_API_KEY, do not fabricate facts or metrics, use public demo mode without an account, and keep Reddit/Hacker News promotion human-reviewed rather than automated.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions only, with no executable scripts, dependency installers, obfuscation, or background setup found in the inspected files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: An optional BLOGBURST_API_KEY is requested for authenticated account actions, which is proportionate to the stated API workflows and is accompanied by explicit secret-handling guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, privilege escalation, credential-store access, broad filesystem indexing, long-running workers, or unrelated mutation authority is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; manual artifact review found no contradictory hidden or unsafe behavior.
[VirusTotal clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious detections; this supports but does not solely determine the benign verdict.
[Optional API key] expected: The API key supports authenticated BlogBurst account workflows and the skill explicitly warns not to print, paste, log, or expose it.
[Public publishing capability] expected: Publishing to connected social channels is high-impact, but it is disclosed as part of the growth-operator workflow and paired with quality-gate and human-review guidance.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending product, marketing, and performance data to BlogBurst and potentially letting it prepare or publish content through connected accounts. Configure BLOGBURST_API_KEY only through the OpenClaw environment or secret store, and keep human review in place before public posts go live.
llm.summary: BlogBurst is a disclosed marketing-growth skill that uses optional BlogBurst API access for content generation, publishing workflows, and attribution without hidden code or unsafe install behavior.
